title: Equipment Datasheet - RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR (KC-4501)
content:
EQUIPMENT DATASHEET: KC-4501 (RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR).
Document No: TJC-LLD-DS-KC-4501, Revision: Rev 3, Status: Issued for Operation.
Equipment Type: Reciprocating Compressor (2-stage).
Plant Unit: Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) Unit, Area: 4500 – Gas Recovery & Compression.
Functional Location: TJC-LLD-4500-01, Criticality: High Critical.
Service: Compress recycle ethylene/hexane vapour back to reactor loop.
MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Compressor Type: RECIPROCATING, 2-STAGE, 2-THROW; Cylinder Material: NODULAR CAST IRON; Piston Rings: PTFE FILLED; Capacity (Suction): 1250 Nm3/h; Packing: PTFE RINGS, DISTANCE PIECE; Suction Pressure: 1.2 barg; Valves: PLATE TYPE, SS; Discharge Pressure: 12.5 barg; Lube System: FORCED FEED + FRAME SPLASH; Suction Temp.: 40 °C; Seal Gas: NITROGEN BUFFER; Discharge Temp.: 115 °C (max); Cooling: JACKET WATER + INTERCOOLER EA-4502; Gas: ETHYLENE / HEXANE / H2 MIX; Vibration Mon.: VT-4501 CROSSHEAD
MOTOR & ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Driver Type: Electric Motor, 4-pole; Output: 250 kW; Enclosure: WPII; Poles: 4 POLE; Area Classification: ZONE 2, IIB T3; Speed: 1485 rpm; Ex Protection: Ex px IIB T3; Voltage: 6000 V / 3 Ph / 50 Hz; Frame: IEC 355; Rated Current: 30 A; Weight (Motor): 1980 kg; Insulation Class: F
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-4501, Interlock: SEQ-4501.
